name: mushroomdb
description: Embedded graph database with incremental association rules and a built-in MCP stdio server for AI agents.
tools_note: Every tool here is callable. A default `tools/list` follows the store the server opened: a store a repository was ingested into advertises three — explore, query, stats — and any other store advertises thirteen, the association surface — query, explain_association, neighborhood, node_info, node_edges, was_linked, node_history, edge_history, find_similar, hybrid_search, remember, recall, stats. The rest are hidden rather than absent, because the schemas cost more than a session gets back. Run `mushroomdb mcp <db> --all-tools` to advertise this whole list.
